modules.title: Number Skills & Operations
modules.description: Counting, addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

questions.question: What is 2 + 3?
questions.explanation: 2 + 3 = 5. Imagine 2 apples 🍎🍎 plus 3 more apples 🍎🍎🍎 = 5 apples!

questions.question: What is 10 - 4?
questions.explanation: 10 - 4 = 6. Take away 4 from 10 fingers and you have 6 left!

questions.question: What is 25 ÷ 5?
questions.explanation: 25 ÷ 5 = 5. Share 25 candies equally among 5 friends — each gets 5!

modules.title: Word Problems & Formulas
modules.description: Solve real-world problems and learn to correct errors.

questions.question: If you have 3 cats and get 2 more, how many cats do you have?
A box holds 4 apples. How many apples are in 3 boxes?
questions.explanation: 4 apples in each box × 3 boxes = 12 apples.

questions.question: Find the error: 5 + 3 = 9. What is the correct answer?
What is the formula for the area of a rectangle?
questions.explanation: To find the area of a rectangle, multiply its length by its width.
